newsitem.title: USA: Metal Management to merge with Proler.
newsitem.headline: Metal Management to merge with Proler.

text.p: Metal Management Inc said Tuesday it, Proler Southwest Inc and Proler Steelworks LLC signed a binding letter of intent to merge the three companies.
This would push Metal Management's estimated gross annual revenues to more than $530 million.
Proler Southwest recycles industrial ferrous scrap in Houston, Texas. Proler Steelworks has national account relationships at its industrial recycling facility in Jackson, Miss.

Following the transaction, Bill Proler, president of Proler Southwest, will join Metal Management's board of directors, and he and his brother Ronny Proler will manage Metal Management's Houston and Gulf States regional operations under the name Proler Southwest.
Closing will require shareholder and regulatory approval and completion of certain financing arrangements.
